name: Replication data for: Moral Foundations Questionnaire: US national representative sample data Spring 2011
description: This dataset contains the MFQ, liberal-conservative ideology, PID, and demographic inoformation from a large national US sample collected in Spring 2011. It is a small portion of a larger dataset exploring the interelations between ideology and American foreign policy attitudes and policy preferences.
citation: Peter Gries, 2011, "Replication data for: Moral Foundations Questionnaire: US national representative sample data Spring 2011", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/EL4KPR, Harvard Dataverse, V1
